kitDescription: Snow White (base, AR/Iron/Attacker/Burst III) is a self-sufficient sustained-DPS attacker. Every 30 normal-attack hits she deals a bonus instance of 82.8% of final ATK to the target and grants herself ATK +8.28% for 5 sec — which, at her fire cadence (a proc roughly every 2.5s), holds near-permanent uptime. Her S2 periodically deals 144.73% of final ATK to enemies in range, and when that skill triggers during Full Burst she gains Critical Rate +26.1% for 10 sec. Her Burst swaps her weapon to a 5-sec-charge cannon: a piercing shot for 499.5% of final ATK whose full-charge coefficient is ×10 (4995%), limited to one round per burst. Against a Fire boss she has no elemental advantage (Iron beats Electric, not Fire), so her damage rides purely on the charge multiplier, Full-Burst major, core, and her self-buffed crit.

verdictRationale: GO. All five kit lines are FAITHFUL: S1 rider (82.8, hitCount-30, 58 fires == floor(1743/30)), S1 self-ATK (8.28, self, 5s, near-100% uptime), S2 AoE (144.73, interval, 11 procs at exact 15s multiples, enemy), S2 crit (26.1, generic critRatePct, self, 10s, FB-related), and the burst cannon (499.5 x10 pierce core FB-major-by-landing, 6 == burstCast). The two blind re-derivations converge on EVERY load-bearing magnitude — most importantly both independently derived the x10 full-charge MULTIPLIER (4995%) from 'Full Charge Damage 1000% of damage', avoiding the additive-1499.5% trap the S2b review ranked #1. The only S5 'divergences' are RECON_ERROR schema no-ops (§6 i–v: the blind test scanned ov.blocks[] on a slot-keyed override, used totalDamage vs total, and filtered bucket 'charge' vs 'burst') — its positive intent, remapped to the driver schema, converges GREEN, and the driver's own 22/22-passing test (§8) supplies the real discrimination (each line RED vs its named nearest-wrong). Fire-rate check passes: no modeled-but-inert line — all five blocks fire at the prose-implied cadence over 180s. Two mechanism divergences are DOCUMENTED, not gotchas: (a) S4 crit trigger fullBurstEnter vs the prose-literal inFb-gated interval cast, and (b) the burst delayed-flatDamage vs prose-literal weaponSwap. In BOTH cases both blind roles read the prose-literal alternative and the driver shipped the owner-ruled / footage-corrected model; the magnitudes converge either way. The same-model residual the owner should spot-check is precisely these two: fact(e) (critFrames==fbFrames) and fact(f) measure the SHIPPED OVERRIDE, not the game — the independent ground truth is the 2026-07-20 owner footage ruling, so the owner should confirm on sw.MP4 that (i) the 26.1% crit buff lands at the FB-entry frame rather than the in-FB S2-cast frame, and (ii) her AR fire is uninterrupted through the ~5s burst charge (validating no weaponSwap). Documented residuals (c) Normal-Attack-Damage fidelity gap, (d) pierce core+body double-hit, and (e) S2 first-fire-phase + FB-scoping flags are all correctly inert at scope and flagged with recipes. Nothing must change for GO; faithfulness 1.0.
